claims.text: Lignin-based polyurethane foams have been made in a one-step foaming method for antimicrobial wound care.
Your proposal targets flexible polyurethane foams with 30 % bio-content from fractionated kraft and organosolv lignin.
High-performance flexible lignin polyurethane foams can be made in one pot with a green co-solvent.
Durability against commercial petroleum-based foams over 50,000 cycles is not yet benchmarked.
